verdict.rationale: Search across tasks, docs, and comments is a fair question for a work-management product like monday.com, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a global or cross-content search capability or its speed and accuracy. The AI 'insights' marketing claim and the GraphQL API are adjacent features or building blocks, not a search feature, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can search across all tasks, docs, and comments and get fast, accurate results
